title: Sprout Teens Bulletin — Spring
summary: Teens kickoff, the storm week of the Rooted guide, and the serve weekend.

items: 13 Sep — Sprout Teens Kickoff, 4pm in the Loft
Term theme — Habits: Rooted's week on storms is your don't-miss week
Take the challenge: one phone-free hour with the guide each week

blocks.text: Your Spring guide, Roots & Shoots, is built for the real weather of being a teen — identity, friends, pressure, storms. The study habit that makes it work is the one the guide is named after: roots you grow before the storm hits. Same time each week, the Loft and the week's verses, phone away, journal open. The storms will come; roots decide whether you sway or stand.
I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.
